hook: AI discovered vulnerabilities in the language that powers most websites.
hooks: AI discovered vulnerabilities in the language that powers most websites.
Governments and companies rushed to patch the bugs overnight.
The language is vital to 70% of websites globally.
what_happened: AI-assisted tools uncovered vulnerabilities in the programming language that powers most websites, prompting governments and companies to issue urgent security updates.
why_it_matters: Fixing the bugs helps keep the majority of web traffic safe from attacks.
caption: AI tools have uncovered security flaws in the programming language that runs most websites, affecting 70% of global web traffic. Has a site you use ever gone offline?
alt_text: The slides explain that AI found bugs in the language powering most websites, prompting urgent patches, and note that it affects 70% of sites.
